info.title: hydrus-go HTTP API
info.description: Machine-readable description of the currently implemented hydrus-go daemon HTTP surface. This spec intentionally describes the implemented migration slice, not full Hydrus Client API parity. Protected operations prefer header credentials; the current implementation also accepts the same access/session key names as query parameters for compatibility.

tags.name: assets
tags.description: Managed original and thumbnail streaming endpoints

tags.description: Tag autocomplete and narrow PTR pending-add staging

tags.description: Daemon-owned PTR status, trigger, pending count, and commit endpoints

HydrusAccessKey.name: Hydrus-Client-API-Access-Key
HydrusAccessKey.description: 64-character hex access key. Preferred auth mechanism for protected endpoints.

HydrusSessionKey.name: Hydrus-Client-API-Session-Key
HydrusSessionKey.description: 64-character hex session key minted from /session_key. Preferred auth mechanism for protected endpoints.

version.description: Hydrus Client API version injected by the server.

hydrus_version.description: Hydrus compatibility target injected by the server.

FileMetadataRow.description: Hydrus-compatible metadata row. The current migration slice returns a dynamic object with fields varying by request flags.

AddTagsRequest.description: Current implementation supports local current-tag writes via service_keys_to_tags or service_names_to_tags, plus PTR pending-add staging through service_keys_to_actions_to_tags with CONTENT_UPDATE_PEND (2).

next_update_due.description: Unix seconds timestamp from remote PTR metadata.

parameters.name: service_key
parameters.description: Hex service key. Provide either service_key or service_name.

parameters.name: service_name
parameters.description: Public discovery-visible service name. Provide either service_key or service_name.

post.description: Accepts either a JSON local-path request or a raw application/octet-stream body, matching the common hydrus-api client shapes used by hydownloader.
Attaches one or more known URLs to existing files. Current implementation supports add-only URL writes.
Current implementation supports modified-file and modified-domain timestamps.

parameters.name: hashes
parameters.description: JSON-encoded array of SHA-256 hex hashes.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Tag prefix. Blank or omitted values return an empty suggestion list.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Repeat this parameter for AND-tag queries.

parameters.name: system_predicates[]
parameters.description: Repeat this parameter for supported size/width/height/favorite/resolution predicates.

400.description: Invalid URL import request or remote URL fetch failure

file_modified_at_ms.description: Unix milliseconds as a string field.
